native: build/solve_result INPUT.bin RESULT.bin [MAX_INPUT_BYTES]; optional positive uint64 caller input limit, otherwise only checked integer/file extents, never a fixed pilot cap. Reuses A49 component_io.hpp; writes only result R/L.
create: with FinalBank(path, times_float64, dimension, slots, statistics=-1_or_1, order=1_to_5, beta=1, max_bank_bytes=None) as bank; optional caller-declared cap includes both exact .npy headers and numeric arrays
solve: solve_supplied(times, source_ret, source_less, kernel_ret, kernel_less, statistics=..., order=..., binary=..., bank=bank, slot=..., source_bindings=[actual_original_raw_byte_bindings], beta=1, timeout=120, max_input_bytes=None, max_result_bytes=None) -> committed slot receipt
finalize: bank.finalize() -> final bank directory; requires every slot committed
consume: load_solution(directory) -> metadata and read-only NumPy memmaps ret/less, shape [slot,time,time,row,column]; caller closes returned ret._mmap/less._mmap after last use
resume: FinalBank(directory,resume=True) validates persisted shape and all committed slot canonical numeric hashes; incomplete slots are not replayed or resumed automatically; an existing staging path fails closed
staging: Only new bank/.staging/slot-NNN/input.bin and result.bin are ephemeral; exact paths declared in invocation.json before native call. They are unlinked only after final ret/less mmap flush, file fsync, canonical per-slot numeric hashes and durable atomic receipts/slot-NNN.json. Invocations, native argv/stdout/stderr/time/status and release receipts remain. No old data is deleted.
sourcekind: single-physical-Hermitian-contour; causal R; lesser exchange reconstruction only within the declared single Hermitian object; independent paired-q/nonphysical raw legs rejected, never projected or reverse-manufactured
layout: little-endian IEEE float64 times; complex128 row-major matrices; ret triangle (n,m) n>=m; lesser triangle (m,n) n>=m. Fortran/strided/big-endian complex128 inputs converted during bounded row packing. Lower precision rejected. Raw R diagonal and lesser diagonal copied verbatim.
algorithm: Direct include of unchanged A54 supplied_keldysh.hpp, which itself includes unchanged A49 supplied_vie2.hpp. Exact admitted retardedVIE2/two-sided initial+noise/independent F-Fcc algorithm, preparation/statistics/theta0 unchanged. No copied or second mathematics implementation.
diagnostic_companions: Only real diagnostic consumers remain on immutable attempts/0054/supplied_keldysh.py/.hpp/solve_components.cpp. Production never serializes/decodes F/Fcc and never emits duplicate slot solution.npz/input.npz.
bounded_storage_scope: Sequential slots, one active native slot and mapped final banks; Python validation/hashing uses individual dxd blocks and packing one triangle time-row. Native solver still has its admitted complete single-slot histories/scratch and residual computation. This is not constant-memory in time or an internal native solver algorithm rewrite. Production has no fixed64MiB cap; this task's physical benchmark payload remains <=64MiB.
planning: plan_layout(time_count, dimension, slots=1, max_input_bytes=None, max_result_bytes=None, max_bank_bytes=None) returns exact triangle count, input/result binary bytes, shape, each .npy header/payload and total final-bank bytes without allocating arrays or files. Optional caller resource limits are enforced independently; None only enforces native header/matrix and addressable-file integer representation. Full31x114 Gamma and31x128x12 fermion bank layouts are plans only, not material31 collision solves or native working-set measurements.
recovery_scope: Completed numeric slot only, not in-flight native solver history. No multiwriter synchronization. Borrowed NumPy views must not outlive mapping owners. Native process failure retains input/output staging and all receipts for diagnosis; no silent retries. Old full companion implementation remains historical and unchanged.
